senses.gloss: (cmp. ברא) to take out (a piece of dough) and shape, to form.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 5:1">Men. V, 1</cite>; Sifra Emor Par. 10, ch. XIII <he>השאור בּוֹדֶה וכ׳</he> he gets the leaven required for the loaves out of themselves (taking a piece of dough out of that intended for the loaves).
<cite ref="Nedarim 10a:12">Ned. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>לשון שבָּדוּ וכ׳</he> terms (for vows) which the Scholars have (arbitrarily) invented (as disguises).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:9">Lev. R. s. 9</cite> <he>לשון בָּדוּי</he> an invented expression.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> <he>דברים בְּדוּיִים</he> fictitious words.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="B00128">same</cite>. Y. Meg. I, 71ᶜ top <he>בי׳ להן וכ׳</he> made up for them a false Latin translation (of the Bible) from the Greek; v. <cite ref="B01335"><he>בָּרַר</he></cite>.—Y. Keth. II, 26ᵇ bot. <he>מְבַדִּין היינו</he> we have been inventing, i.e. speaking in fun; <cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 2:1">Tosef. ib. II, 1</cite> <he>מבודין אנו</he> (corr. acc.; Var. <he>בדאים</he>). [Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵈ <he>מבדין אתם וכ׳</he>, prob. to be read <he>מן הדין</he>.] [Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵇ bot. <he>מבדין בחדשים</he>, v. <cite ref="B00162"><he>בָּהָה</he></cite>.]
to disprove, refute. Tanḥ. Balak, 14; ed. Bub. 23 (ref. to baddim, Is. XLIV, 25) מְבַדִּין וכ׳ they frustrate their predictions.
to be tempted to a falsehood, turn a liar.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 4a:6">Ber. 4ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Zuta 3">Der. Er. Zut. ch. III</cite> train thy tongue to say, I do not know, <he>שמא תִּתְבַּדֶּה וכ׳</he> lest thou be induced to tell a falsehood and be caught.
